title: Token.identityRegistry points to IdentityRegistry
desc: Token must reference the correct IdentityRegistry; mismatch or missing getter = FAIL

title: IdentityRegistry wired with ClaimTopicsRegistry
desc: IdentityRegistry must point to valid ClaimTopicsRegistry; wrong or empty CTR = FAIL

title: IdentityRegistry wired with TrustedIssuersRegistry
desc: IdentityRegistry must reference valid TrustedIssuersRegistry; wrong TIR = FAIL

title: Token exposes setIdentityRegistry(address)
desc: Admin must be able to update IdentityRegistry; missing setter = FAIL

title: IdentityRegistry exposes setTrustedIssuersRegistry(address)
desc: Admin must be able to reconfigure TrustedIssuersRegistry; missing setter = FAIL

title: IdentityRegistry has isVerified(address)
desc: KYC verification must be exposed; missing getter = FAIL

title: Token checks compliance hooks
desc: Token must call compliance.canTransfer and other hooks; absence = WARN

title: Agent role management present
desc: Token must have addAgent/removeAgent; missing = FAIL

title: Ownable initializers called (non-zero owner)
desc: Owner addresses of registries must be non-zero; uninitialized = FAIL
